params.script:
#!/bin/sh

docker run --rm \
  --network host \
  -v /home/ubuntu/work/fisgon:/app \
  -v /home/ubuntu/data_storage:/home/ubuntu/data_storage \
  -w /app \
  -e TARGET_CITY=Almeria \
  -e OPERATION=0 \
  -e TARGET_SCRAPER=${SCRAPER_NAME} \
  fisgon_scraper:1.0
